description: A run that findings fail names, for each subject of a failing finding, the change kinds.json's remedies give that subject and only the suppression records its suppressions name: a declaration finding offers a directive, an ignore entry or a baseline row, while a file finding and a configuration-record finding offer none, because no suppression record can name a file or a record of deadset's own configuration.

stdout_contains:
remediation: for each failing finding about a declaration: delete the symbol, or wire it up so the program uses it; or record an adjudication with its reason in an inline directive, a deadset-ignore.json entry or a deadset-baseline.json row
remediation: for each failing finding about a file: delete the file, name it as a root, or build it in a configuration of the build matrix; no suppression can name a file
remediation: for each failing finding about a record of deadset's own configuration: correct or remove the record the finding names; no suppression can name a record of deadset's own configuration
